name: Short-Baseline Neutrino (SBN) Programme
notes: IMPORTANT: collaboration:sbn is not a fourth experiment collaboration. It is the umbrella programme joining three separate detector collaborations — ICARUS (far detector), SBND (near detector) and, in its original 2015 proposal, MicroBooNE — sharing one Booster Neutrino Beam line at Fermilab to search for sterile neutrinos and measure neutrino-argon cross sections. No experiment:sbn entity exists; the programme's physics is carried by experiment:icarus, experiment:sbnd and (historically) experiment:microboone.

summary.plain: Not one experiment but a joint programme: three liquid-argon detectors (ICARUS, SBND, and originally MicroBooNE) sharing Fermilab's Booster neutrino beam to hunt for a possible fourth kind of neutrino.
summary.technical: Umbrella Short-Baseline Neutrino programme proposed in March 2015 (arXiv:1503.01520) by the ICARUS-WA104, LAr1-ND (later SBND) and MicroBooNE collaborations, reusing the refurbished ICARUS-T600 as far detector and a new near detector (SBND) on the BNB at Fermilab.
